messages:
zara: Deploybot alerted on a gradual error-rate increase for v5.0.0 in eu-central canary. errors up ~4x on 5% slice. auto-revert is suppressed due to change window. can we decide pin vs rollback?
kevin: what's the signal? errors or latency? any stack traces?
zara: errors (500s) from model-runtime; p95 also crept from 220ms -> 410ms. small slice but we should act.
tom: if auto-revert blocked, do a targeted rollback for the canary slice only and pin the route until we validate. keeps prod green.
deploybot: [ALERT] canary_error_rate (id cb-8244). errors increased to 4.1% from 0.9%. auto-revert disabled by maintenance-window policy.
kevin: any dedicated customers on eu-central canary route?
zara: none — only internal test tenants. blast radius low.
rachel-cs: i'll prepare a minimal CS note; need a 1-line cause and ETA for update.
kevin: plan: 1) pin route to v4.9.8, 2) run rollback for canary slice -> v4.9.8, 3) update release-notes and customer blurb. tom you can execute?
tom: executing pin now: `redwood route pin --region=eu-central --route=canary --version=v4.9.8 --actor=tom`
deploybot: [ACTION] Route pinned by tom at 4832100015. pinned -> v4.9.8.
tom: starting rollback for canary: `./rollback-script --to=v4.9.8 --region=eu-central --slice=canary` (start 20:12 UTC)
deploybot: [ACTION] Rollback initiated by tom at 4832100022. progress: 40% -> 80% -> 100%.
tom: rollback complete. errors dropped to baseline (~0.8%) and p95 back to ~230ms. monitoring 10m.
kevin: good. rachel can you post CS note: "Small canary rollback to previous stable version due to increased runtime errors; no customer data impacted; monitoring continues."
rachel-cs: posted to #customer-ops and queued email for impacted dev tenants. added timestamps.
legal-bot: Reminder: any customer-facing comms referencing incidents must be reviewed if enterprise customers were impacted. none found on this slice; proceeding.
ops-bot: 10m check: error-rate and p95 stable. closing incident in 30m if no regression.
zara: johnny follow-up: open ENG-PR-991 to run reproducer and check model runtime upgrade path. add release-notes entry and tag commit #canary-rollback-4832109999.
kevin: release-notes updated and commit tagged.
tom: leaving pin in place for 1 hour, then plan to unpin if metrics remain green or roll forward with a patch.
zara: thanks team. will open postmortem if root cause not immediately apparent. closing thread.
